Subject: AWS Marketplace listing - go-to-market & UX copy check

Hi Sarah —

Attaching a fresh pass at the AWS Marketplace product page copy and a lightweight MAP for co-sell alignment. High level asks:
- Can you confirm the co-sell qualification criteria for G2/Marketplace badges?
- Any constraints on pricing tiers / SKU naming we should follow so procurement maps cleanly?
- Do you want the technical AMI/packaging note included on the page or linked to a support doc?

Attachments: aws_listing_draft_v3.docx, AWS_MAP_template.xlsx

We kept the hero short and benefits-first (cost, latency, privacy controls) but added a small section about Dedicated vs Private deployments. Would appreciate any marketplace-specific phrasing you prefer.

Thanks — I can iterate quickly once you flag items.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa — quick read looks good. A few asks from our side:

- Please provide a completed MAP with milestones and owner fields (sales enablement, technical onboarding, marketplace launch date). I added Alan (procurement) to the thread for SKU/pricing alignment.
- For co-sell badging, we require a short partner benefits blurb (<= 120 chars) that mentions joint support and go-to-market motion.
- Security artifacts: we need your SOC2 summary and a short note on data residency for the Private deployment. If those aren't ready, a placeholder with expected delivery date is fine.

Alan — can you confirm any procurement footnote language needed for reserved capacity SKUs?

Sarah Holt
Partner Programs, AcmeCloud Marketplace

Sarah / Alan —

Thanks for the quick turn. Attached are: aws_listing_draft_v3.docx (new hero + bullets), AWS_MAP_template.xlsx (owners + timeline), and a draft co-sell terms PDF for legal to skim.

Quick notes inline:
- MAP proposed launch date: 2027-06-21 (internal launch week + marketplace listing request submitted by 6/14).
- Partner blurb (<=120 chars) suggested: "Redwood Inference + AcmeCloud — production-grade LLM inference with joint support and deployment flexibility."
- SKU approach: we propose two SKUs — "Redwood-Hosted" (usage-based) and "Redwood-Dedicated" (reserved monthly). Alan, does that mapping work for you?
- Security: SOC2 summary is with Security; we can provide a one-page summary by 2027-05-10. Data residency note: "Customers may choose Hosted (multi-region), Dedicated (region-specific), or Private (customer VPC)."

Vanessa / Karthik / Jonas — can you each skim the hero + bullets and call out any must-have language? Vanessa: pricing footnote language; Karthik: technical constraints for the AMI / packaging blurb; Jonas: co-sell contact mapping for field enablement.

Thanks — I'll prep a DocuSign for the co-sell terms after Alan confirms procurement language.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: aws_listing_draft_v3.docx; AWS_MAP_template.xlsx; co-sell-terms-draft.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing - go-to-market & UX copy check

Marissa — quick copy + tech notes below. Pulling out a few things that could improve discoverability on the marketplace UX.

1) Hero line: keep it benefits-first; suggest we add tokenized metric: "Reduce inference cost per token by up to 4x vs standard serving." (only if we can back it with benchmark footnote).
2) Bullets: reorder to lead with deployment options (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) then cost/latency. Many marketplace searches filter on "Private deployment" so that helps.
3) AMI/packaging blurb (short): "AMI image (x86/Graviton) available for Dedicated and Private deployments; container image and Helm chart provided for on-prem."
4) Technical footnote for SKUs: reserved capacity SKU should include "monthly commit" language and a link to the SLA doc.

I'm happy to drop these edits into the doc and send a tracked-changes version.

-Karthik
Senior Product Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alan White <alan.white@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Holt <sarah.holt@acmecloud.com>

Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing - go-to-market & UX copy check

Marissa — thanks for the materials. Procurement is OK with the two-SKU approach. A couple of quick asks before we finalize the listing:

- Please add this footnote under pricing: "Reserved capacity SKUs require a minimum 12-month commit; pricing shown is list and subject to partner negotiated discounts."
- We need a final redirectable link for the technical docs (DocSend is fine). I see you attached a draft; please upload final docs and reply with the DocuSign link for co-sell terms.

For convenience here's a draft DocuSign envelope: https://docsend.com/d/abcd1234 (please confirm once signed).

Alan White
Senior Procurement Manager, AcmeCloud
